column1: # Language guard 2 exemptions: Chinese text in a src/main/java literal that is deliberately not routed
# through the language catalogue. One line per literal, three tab-separated fields:
#   path (relative to the module root) <TAB> the literal exactly as written between its quotes <TAB> reason
# Every line needs a reason. A line that no longer matches a literal fails the build (UltiSideBarCjkLiteralScopeTest).

column3: Default scoreboard line template (config key lines): a PlaceholderAPI layout document the operator edits line by line, written verbatim into config/sidebar.yml. Maintainer ruling 2026-09-24 (d) classes this value as a non-message setting that stays literal: the language catalogue holds only single-string entries, so a list layout has no catalogue path, and the operator replaces the whole template for their server
